decision_rules.constant_rewards: retain full group; no optimizer update and no Development exposure
decision_rules.gradient_or_parameter_delta_invalid: no checkpoint qualification and no Development evaluation
decision_rules.untrusted_or_incomplete_grade: exclude reward; abort optimizer update and preserve failure
decision_rules.valid_update: one update maximum; save adapter/optimizer, fresh reload and digest/step check, then matched unchanged-versus-updated Development evaluation

evaluation.decode: deterministic greedy; identical task prompt, source, tool allowlist, and budgets for both arms; deterministic independent grader; evaluation results withheld between paired attempts

hypothesis: A newly source/test-qualified Train task with no prior model prompt exposure can produce a variable trusted reward group and admit a mathematically valid full-trajectory GRPO update on the pinned local MLX policy.
limitations: This is one single-seed group and two Development tasks.
All tasks are from pydantic/pydantic; cross-repository generalization is not measured.
An executable full-trajectory terminal-reward path does not itself establish successful Long-Horizon RL or recursive improvement.
No held-out claim or promotion is authorized.

model.runtime: local MLX Metal on Apple M1 Pro, 32 GiB unified memory

primary_outcome: whether the full eight-sample trusted group has reward variance and passes all frozen optimizer, parameter-change, save/reload checks; if so, matched Development success delta on two qualified tasks
task_split_rule: Train and Development families and editable production paths must be disjoint. Development task prompts are not sent to the model before a valid optimizer update.

training.credit_assignment: Full-trajectory terminal reward: preserve all policy-generated action segments and assign the trusted terminal advantage to each action token. This is an executable credit-assignment path; a successful Long-Horizon RL outcome is not claimed.
training.objective: One complete same-policy group of eight fresh multi-turn coding-agent trajectories with token-exact behavior probabilities and independently graded terminal rewards. Apply full-trajectory GRPO only if the complete group is trusted, rewards vary, and every optimizer precondition passes.
update_preconditions: complete same-task on-policy group of eight trajectories
finite matching sampling-time and recomputed behavior log-probabilities within 1e-6 for every action segment
checkpoint save and fresh-process reload digest plus optimizer step verified
